function.name: get_occurrence_context
function.description: Read neighbouring parser lines before and after one target in reading order, each with its layout (bbox, font size, bold/italic ratio) and its spatial relation to the target (same baseline, vertical offset, horizontal overlap, font-size delta), plus other lines on the target's baseline (row peers) and page statistics. Observations only.

offset.description: Number of page lines to skip in reading order.
